title: Trade buyer execution context and buyer operation decision
description: ADR-SHARED-042 section 7 (work package CAA-01): the derived, purpose-bound Trade execution object Trade assembles server-side from independently verified facts. The chain is: IAM-verified human, then the CP canonical Principal and ACTIVE ExternalIdentity, then an expressly selected, CP-attested canonical buyer Organisation, then the Trade BuyerOrganisation and current BuyerMembership, then the current operation policy, then the independent CP context and seller authority. It is not a global identity, not a CP PlatformContext, not a credential and not perpetual authority. No browser, client, Medusa customer JWT or background job may submit it as a source of truth. Buyer ALLOW alone never executes a transaction: consequential execution also requires the seller decision (trade/v2 order-authority) and a native execution fence. This contract registers no route, capability or grant.

actorType.description: Only human actors are defined in this version. Machine procurement (registered WORKLOAD Principals with an explicit Organisation mandate, ADR-SHARED-042 section 8) needs its own versioned delegation profile before activation and is refused here.

buyerOperation.description: The exact buyer-side operation evaluated. Seller-side consequential classes remain trade/v2 order-operations.yaml; trade.order.commit and trade.draft-order.finalize appear in both because each needs both decisions.

decisionOutcome.description: ALLOW is the only outcome that can contribute to execution, and only together with the seller decision. APPROVAL_REQUIRED is not executable purchase permission. SELECTION_REQUIRED means no acting Organisation was selected. UNAVAILABLE is retryable and never softened to success.

decisionReason.description: Closed reasons. Reasons for an Organisation the actor cannot act for are never more specific than BUYER_NOT_AUTHORISED, so no foreign record can be probed. SPEND_POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED means no explicit, active spend authority applies for the operation's Market and currency (absence of a limit is never unlimited authority); SPEND_LIMIT_EXCEEDED means an applicable limit exists and the amount exceeds it. APPROVAL_AUTHORITY_NOT_CONFIGURED means the approver has no explicit, active approval limit for that Market and currency; APPROVAL_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED means the amount exceeds an applicable threshold or limit (ADR-SHARED-042 section 14, CAA-05 ruling).

transactionDigest.description: Digest over the immutable commercial facts of the exact resource version (lines, quantities, prices, currency, tax, Incoterm, parties). Any material change invalidates the decision and its approvals.

evidenceReference.description: Redacted upstream provenance (for example a CP decision or attestation id). Never a token, credential or unnecessary personal data.

context_id.description: This Trade context. Distinct from cp_context_id.

actor_principal_id.description: The CP canonical human Principal resolved from verified subject evidence (identity/v1 principal-resolution). Never a Medusa customer, email or a value a caller supplied.

external_identity_id.description: The ACTIVE ExternalIdentity the Principal was resolved through.

tenant_id.description: The seller-side trading Tenant, from Trade's own CP context; never inferred from a browser header or the buyer.

market_id.description: Required for pricing, cart, RFQ, quotation, approval and order operations; resolved through CP market participation, never trusted as requested.

canonical_organisation_id.description: Expressly selected by the actor and attested by CP for the seller-side Tenant. Never the Tenant's own PRIMARY Organisation by default.

membership_revision.description: The membership version evaluated; a later revision invalidates this context.

roles.description: Inputs to the operation policy, never universal permission or platform grants.

cp_context_id.description: Trade's own bounded RUNTIME CP context. Its workload Principal is never the buyer.

approval_references.description: Independent approvals bound to the same Organisation, amount, currency, Market, resource version and digest, each by a Principal distinct from the initiator.

expires_at.description: At most 60 seconds after evaluated_at and never later than the earliest required evidence (token, CP resolution, CP context). A ceiling, not a grace period for revoked authority.

allOf.description: Pricing, cart, RFQ, quotation, approval and order operations are scoped to a Market.
Mutations bind the exact immutable resource version.
An order commitment also binds the seller of record; buyer ALLOW never substitutes for seller authority.
